description: Estimate the chance of making a delivery appointment from miles left, speed variation, stops and the hours of service you have left. Use this tested BusCalc worksheet when the task matches its inputs and scope. Returns named results, units, formula, assumptions, method version and a source-page URL. No prices or omitted costs are looked up; no private projects or purchases are accessed. Put tool fields inside inputs. Supply units or modelVersion only when listed in inputSchema. Follow its required fields and exact choices. Do not pass the REST calculator field inside MCP arguments.

breakAfter.description: Driving allowed before a 30-minute break. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

delay.description: Known extra delay (traffic, weather, construction). Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

driveLeft.description: Driving hours left today. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

milesLeft.description: Miles left to the receiver. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

minutesToAppt.description: Minutes until the appointment. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

qualifyingStop.description: Planned time includes a qualifying break before the driving limit is reached. Use matching records and scope.

sinceBreak.description: Driving hours since your last 30-minute break. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

speed.description: Expected average speed. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

stops.description: Planned stops (fuel, break). Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

variability.description: Typical trip-time variation (standard deviation as a share of driving time). Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

windowLeft.description: Driving-window hours left today. Use matching records and scope. JSON numbers are preferred. Nonblank strings are also accepted when JavaScript Number conversion yields a finite value meeting the same bounds and whole-number rules.

modelVersion.description: Optional expected method version; a mismatch is rejected.
